text:
alice: quick midday standup — gateway/routing/auth/rate checks

alice: what I did: shipped routing-policy v2 canary (10%) for customer-x. tightened route-matching to avoid dual-shard hits.
blocker: seeing intermittent 429s on long-poll endpoints during bursts. not consistent across regions.
today: investigate throttler queue/backpressure, add some lightweight metrics, coordinate PRs for rollback if needed.

ben: digging into the 429s now. spotted connection-queue growth on a subset of pods (older kernel). sample logs:
```
{"level":"warn","msg":"queue_backlog","backlog":42}
```
I think a recent batching tweak + route change increased per-pod token spikes. pinging @carla for the ratepolicy change that rolled yesterday.

carla: rolled a small ratepolicy tweak yesterday (per-user 60->50) to smooth downstream DB writes. Did a canary at 10% only. Didn't expect long-poll 429s but could be interacting with batching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/gateway/pull/1234
If we need fast rollback I can revert.

dave: FYI I kicked off jwt-rotation job in staging earlier. Saw ~0.2% 401s during rotation window — looks like cache invalidation ordering issue (old token rejected before new accepted by edge). I'll add a short grace window and retry logic.

erin: infra-side: adding temporary autoscale rule to spawn extra gateway pods when pod p95 CPU > 75% for 1m, should help absorb bursts while we debug. non-disruptive, ETA ~45m.

alice: action items:
- ben: dig deeper into backlog metrics + pod kernel differences, get pprof if needed.
- carla: prepare revert PR but hold until we confirm.
- dave: patch jwt-rotation with grace/retry and monitor auth logs.
- erin: deploy autoscale tweak and report.
I'll coordinate PR reviews and hold on broad rollout. @deploy-bot please run canary healthcheck after changes :pray:

deploy-bot: scheduled canary healthcheck for gw-canary-2026-03-17T15:40:00Z — will post results here.

ben: quick q — do we want to trial increasing batching window from 50ms -> 75ms in prod? could reduce token churn but add ~10-20ms latency tail.

carla: +0 from me, prefer slight latency tradeoff over 429 risk. happy to trial on canary.

dave: ok to trial in staging, I will watch auth logs for regressions.

erin: autoscale pushed, size + cooldown params in staging now.

alice: thanks all. I'll be on #eng-platform huddle at 16:00 if anyone wants to pair. Standup complete. :thumbsup:
